artists.biography:
Clifford Joseph Price (born 19 September 1965), better known as Goldie, is a British electronic music artist, disc jockey, visual artist and actor. He is well known for his innovations in the jungle and drum and bass music genres. He previously gained exposure for his work as a graffiti artist.
Goldie's acting credits include the James Bond film The World Is Not Enough, Guy Ritchie's Snatch and the British soap opera EastEnders. He has also appeared in a number of celebrity reality television shows including Celebrity Big Brother 2, Strictly Come Dancing and Come Dine with Me.

apple_music.editorial_notes: Goldie's Timeless set the standard for what a drum 'n' bass LP might achieve. In a genre defined by its breakneck pace, the album's opening gambit is a soulful, 21-minute suite, and from there it plunges into double-barrelled percussive assaults, jazzy neo-soul and brooding dance-floor delirium. Goldie's dizzying breakbeat edits come to the fore on the undulating, 12-minute "Jah the Seventh Seal", while "Inner City Life" balances deft drum programming and futuristic synths with heart-rending vocals that sound simply, well, timeless.

lastfm.wiki_content: Timeless is the debut studio album by British electronic musician Goldie. It was released on 7 August 1995 and is universally regarded as a groundbreaking release in the history of drum and bass music. Goldie was joined in the studio by engineer/producer Rob Playford (founder of the Moving Shadow label), who did most of the programming and production, with Goldie generating the musical ideas, rhythms and arrangements. Additional engineering and production came from Dego and Marc Mac of 4hero. Diane Charlemagne contributed the bulk of the vocals. Its title track includes what has become the most recognisable and crossover hit from the album, " Inner City Life ". Tracks such as " Angel ", " You & Me " and " Kemistry " (dedicated to DJ Kemistry) appeared in remastered form from their original 1992/93 versions. Released on Pete Tong's FFRR label, the album reached no. 7 on the UK Albums Chart. Timeless was simultaneously released as a double album and single album. The single album removed four tracks and featured the original mix of " Sensual ". The US release of the double album appended two bonus remixes. Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Goldie’s Timeless is a landmark electronic album that helped carry jungle and drum & bass from underground clubs into the mainstream. Released in 1995, its ambitious sound combines intricate, rapid-fire breakbeats and deep bass with sweeping orchestral textures, ambient atmospheres, jazz, soul, and futuristic electronics. The centerpiece is the expansive title suite, incorporating “Inner City Life,” whose yearning vocals and cinematic scale give the album an emotional reach rarely associated with dance music.

Far more than a collection of club tracks, Timeless is a dramatic, immersive statement shaped by Goldie’s ideas and Rob Playford’s programming and production. Its scale, rhythmic complexity, and melodic ambition earned widespread acclaim, while its success—including a number-seven UK chart placing—helped establish drum and bass as a serious album form. Issued through London Records, this essential electronic recording remains a defining document of 1990s British dance music and a fitting choice for National Album Day 2026.
